countUnit: worktree plus relative path; not unique repository paths or new features
ownerAssignmentMeaning: One disposition owner per entry. Reviewers are proposed review counterparts, not claims of reviews performed or tasks dispatched. Custody does not grant implementation ownership.

Score.scope: Typed Score services, Desktop Score integration and cross-boundary review

Agent.scope: Agent orchestration and its typed-port consumers

Platform.scope: Plugin identity, SDK, contribution ownership and session assembly

Kernel.scope: Rust Kernel and interpretation of historical Kernel evidence

Coordination.scope: Evidence custody, disposition decisions and reports; not a new business implementation owner

categories.delivered-duplicate: Matches the selected current owner reference in full, allowing only CRLF-to-LF normalization. Do not duplicate the delivery or delete the local copy.
categories.superseded: An older or incomplete version relative to the selected owner/current main. Retain the current implementation; preserve the legacy bytes pending approved disposition.
categories.nonfunctional-only: Inspected difference is comments or blank lines only. This is not full-file equality and not a new feature.
categories.review-required-hunk: Potentially distinct intent mixed with stale code. Preserve and review only identified hunks after separate authorization; no whole-file copy.
categories.historical-record: Historical evidence or task-state snapshot, not current task authority or new runtime work.
categories.retired-prototype: Historical prototype marked retired in its own README. Preserve for archival assessment, not active-source integration or visual review.
categories.coordination-record: Unique coordination notes with older status claims; reconcile separately without overwriting the original.
